purpose: Durable one-to-many Scene ID -> Topview render-attempt history. Scene IDs identify creative scenes; Topview task IDs identify individual render attempts.
authority: Telemetry/provenance mapping only. Google Drive video-prompts.md remains canonical for active scenes, editorial state and slow membership.
rules: Scene ID identifies a creative scene; Topview task ID identifies one render attempt. A scene may have many attempts over time or in parallel.
A new task for an existing scene is appended to attempt history and does not create a duplicate Scene ID.
A new active attempt (init/queued/running/processing) makes or returns that existing Scene ID to canonical slow, even if an older attempt previously completed or the scene had been removed from slow.
Preserve every known task_id/outcome. Do not overwrite history when selecting a new current task.
Several active attempts of one scene still produce one canonical slow Scene ID; track every active task ID.
Topview success never implies approval and never clears canonical slow automatically.
Create a new Scene ID only for a genuinely new creative scene; ambiguous classification requires user review.
